cohort: 3,108 pregnant women with schizophrenia and 12,432 matched controls without severe mental disorders
finding: Compared to matched controls, pregnant women with schizophrenia had a higher risk of pregnancy complications, delivery complications, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Women with schizophrenia had a higher rate of caesarean sections compared to matched controls (aOR=1.15[95%CI 1.05-1.25]).
birth_weight: Newborns of women with schizophrenia had more low birth weight (aOR=1.75[95%CI 1.53-2.00])
